description: This file defines a highlight function for text highlighting with options for diacritic insensitivity, case sensitivity, and pattern matching, used in the typeahead.js library.

methods.name: hightlight
methods.description: Main function to highlight patterns within a DOM node based on specified options.

methods.name: getRegex
methods.description: Constructs a regex pattern from input patterns, considering case sensitivity, words only, and diacritic insensitivity.

methods.name: accent_replacer
methods.description: Replaces characters with their accented counterparts for diacritic insensitivity.

methods.name: traverse
methods.description: Recursively traverses DOM nodes to apply highlighting to text nodes.
